T: All work and no play. So, dinner.
D: A writer takes a winter job as caretaker of an empty mountain hotel with his wife and son.
P: Serve the drinks when Jack sits down at the Gold Room bar.
S: Hallorann's tour of the giant pantry

A big board of marinated olives, pickled vegetables, salami, provolone and grissini, laid out in neat rows like the stacked tins in the hotel stores. Warm 250g mixed olives in 60ml olive oil with strips of orange peel, 1 sliced garlic clove and chilli flakes for 5 minutes, then cool. Slice 150g salami and 150g provolone. Arrange on a big board in tidy rows with the olives, 200g giardiniera pickled vegetables, 100g marinated artichokes, 1 packet grissini and a handful of cornichons. Serve at room temperature.
Hedge maze herb crackers and whipped feta
the hedge maze outside, under the snow

Parmesan and herb crackers scored with a maze pattern and studded with rosemary and parsley, with a snowy whipped feta dip. Rub 80g cold butter into 150g plain flour, 40g grated parmesan, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 1 tbsp chopped parsley and half a tsp salt, then add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to bring it together. Chill 20 minutes, roll 3mm thick between baking paper and cut into squares. Score a maze into each with a knife. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest.

Warm mixed nuts roasted with butter, brown sugar, rosemary and a pinch of cayenne until glossy, served in silver bowls along the Gold Room bar. Toss 400g mixed unsalted nuts with 30g melted butter, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 1 tsp salt flakes and a pinch of cayenne. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 180C for 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden and fragrant. Cool for 5 minutes so the coating sets, then serve warm in small bowls.
M: the walk-in freezer tour, Dick knows every shelf

Leg of lamb studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink with crisp potatoes cooked in the pan juices and a rich gravy, carved at the table. Stud a 2kg leg of lamb with 4 sliced garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs, rub with oil, salt and pepper. Roast at 200C for 1 hour 20 minutes with 1kg quartered potatoes around it. Rest 15 minutes and make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
the tray Wendy takes up to Jack

Soft buttery scrambled eggs on sourdough with crisp bacon, grilled tomato and mushrooms, fresh orange juice and a pot of coffee, all on one tray. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Halve 4 tomatoes and grill 6 minutes. Sauté 250g mushrooms in 20g butter. Whisk 8 eggs with 60ml cream and salt and cook over low heat in 30g butter, stirring slowly, for 4 to 5 minutes until just set. Toast 4 slices sourdough. Plate on trays with a glass of fresh orange juice squeezed from 6 oranges and a pot of coffee.
W: he asks Danny if he likes chocolate ice cream
Cream and milk warmed with dark chocolate and cocoa, whisked into yolks and sugar, cooked to 82C, chilled and churned.
K: Jack's order from Lloyd at the Gold Room

Bourbon stirred down with a little demerara syrup and aromatic bitters over one big ice block, finished with a twist of orange peel. For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon, 10ml demerara sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters with ice in a mixing glass for 20 seconds. Strain into a rocks glass over one large ice block. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in. Totals are 240ml bourbon, 40ml syrup and 1 orange.

w.note: he asks Danny if he likes chocolate ice cream
w.how: Warm 400ml cream and 300ml milk with 150g dark chocolate and 2 tbsp cocoa. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook, stirring, to 82C. Chill overnight and churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.
